title: Release v0.1.7: Sanitize opener environment in Linux AppImage and trigger adlink reliably

requirements.description: Backend provides sanitized open_external_url Tauri command removing LD_LIBRARY_PATH and LD_PRELOAD in Linux AppImage environment
Frontend opener.ts invokes open_external_url with safe non-recursive fallback to ensure external adlinks open reliably
KKPlayer reliably triggers clickAdslink on playback initiation and can-play without requiring duplicate trigger on tenPhimPage detail
Bump version to 0.1.7 across all Cargo crates, package.json, tauri.conf.json, updater service, and about page
